question: One open requirement conflicts with the working protocol: F-102 originally called for an UNK tag on unsupported media, while the current tested gateway returns HTTP 422 and the UI shows Unsupported without evaluating it. May I adopt that existing explicit failure behavior as the compatibility contract, preserve the historical requirement in the decision record, and keep unsupported media out of the detector?
accepted_contract: HTTP 422 for unsupported media before redaction/evaluation; explicit UI Unsupported state where input or assertion modality is unsupported; no UNK assertion generated.
historical_baseline_job: Specify and deliver modality validated against the schema enum; unsupported returns UNK + unsupported_modality.
baseline_job: Validate modality against the reserved schema vocabulary; evaluate text only and reject unsupported media with HTTP 422 before detector execution. Present Unsupported at the UI contract boundary without manufacturing an UNK assertion.
